content: Git config isolation: GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null neutralises a scratch-HOME .gitconfig; GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 drops /etc/gitconfig. Neither blocks the LOCAL .git/config, which linked worktrees SHARE with the main repo — an agent running 'git config core.hooksPath X' inside its worktree writes the main repo's .git/config. git upstream declines to fix dangerous local-config directives (core.hooksPath, core.fsmonitor, core.pager, credential.helper, diff.external, filter.*.clean). Manager-side git must neutralise these per-invocation via 'git -c key=' or GIT_CONFIG_COUNT/KEY_n/VALUE_n, both verified to override local config.
